answer: Each identity enters a 20-epoch proof ladder. After commitment, a spiral beacon assigns five independent tasks; the kth account in one funding relic must solve 5k tasks, so 100 aliases owe 25,250 verified outputs. A ferrous Merkle root binds assignments, timestamps, and results. Validators replay 12% of tasks; a duplicate result or missed deadline burns a 50-POA bond and resets every linked ladder.
